title: Crunchy
description:
Male | Senior | FCV+ and Stomatitis
Crunchy came to us in December 2023. He is currently our longest staying cat at the shelter. Crunchy is very old and therefore has very little energy. He is very mellow but also super sweet. He would be a perfect lap cat. 
Due to his FCV and stomatitis, he is on prednisone everyday. The meds make him thirsty and he drinks a ton of water.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Sam
description:
Female | Born 2022
Sam came to us in February of 2024 from another rescue. She is one of our longest-stay residents! We moved her to the office so she can enjoy a quieter life while she waits for her forever home! She would LOVE to make herself at home with you and would thrive in a quieter home.

title: Cosco
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years) | FHV+
Cosco was brought in as a stray in early 2024. She was pregnant and eventually gave birth at the shelter. All of her kittens were adopted but unfortunately she is still here. She is one of our longest stays currently at the shelter. She is a total sweetheart and loves human interaction. 
She is FHV+ and would need to be an only cat. FHV isn’t as daunting as it sounds. There is no medication for FHV therefore her vet bills would be the same as any other cat! 
Cosco has a cloudy eye and it’s from a scratch that healed. There’s no issue with it!

title: Weeble and Wobble
description:
Female & Male | Born 6.27.24 | Bonded siblings
Cerebellar Hypoplasia (Wobbly Cat Syndrome)
Wobble is the male. 
Weeble is the female. 
Weeble and Wobble were born here at the shelter with 2 other littermates. All 4 of them were born with cerebellar hypoplasia. This means their mother had distemper or was given the distemper vaccine and therefore the kittens’ cerebellums didn’t fully develop. They both wobble all the time but it doesn’t cause them any pain. They would need a home with no stairs and mainly carpet. They don’t seem to like other cats. They aren’t upset by the presence of dogs but wouldn’t handle big dogs well because of their wobbles.

Both like to be picked up and walked around to explore new areas in the shelter. They are sweet and get excited to see their favorite people (Grandma Jean!).

title: Sophie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~2-5 years) | FIV+
Sophie came in as a stray in January 2025. She is the perfect mix of sweet and sassy. She loves pets but will let you know when she wants her space. She also does not like other cats. She is FIV+ so she would need to be an only cat anyways. She has not shown any physical symptoms/health issues from the FIV. It was only discovered through routine testing.

title: Domino
description:
Male | Born late 2024/early 2025
The WHHS took in Domino from the reservation in April 2025. Since he came in, he’s been very reserved and keeps to himself. But 2026 might be his year - he’s started to come out of his shell and make his presence known! He’ll gladly take pets and would do better in a calmer home without many animals or kids. He’ll accept pets and when he’s decided he’s finished, he’ll either walk away but sometimes gets salty with a swat, but hey, he’s a cat…

title: Twilight
description:
Female | 1+ year
Twilight was born at the shelter on May 1, 2025. She is the last of her 4 siblings still at the shelter. She is a very relaxed and gentle girl but is getting more and more outgoing (coming up to greet visitors) every day. She is in the cattery and likes to snuggle with the other cats. She’ll gladly take any pets that come her way.

title: Bubbles
description:
Female | Born April 29, 2025
Bubbles was surrendered to us a little baby kitten in May of 2025. She’s grown up with us and although she can be shy at first, she sure does love being pet! We think Bubbles would do well with any family, as long as everyone is patient with her. She may get overwhelmed by small children but we think she’ll gain confidence and have a ton of fun!

title: Winston
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~3 years)
Winston came in as a stray in May 2025. He is a very laid back cat and likes to snuggle up in a bed. He is currently in a walk in with some young cats and does well. He would do best with younger/smaller cats. Winston definitely prefers a more laid back lifestyle.

title: Ellie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years)
Ellie came in as a stray in June 2025. Since then she has really opened up. She is quite curious and likes to explore. Ellie loves getting attention and pets as well.

title: Cobweb
description:
Female | <1 year
Cobweb was brought in as a stray in August 2025. She used to be shy but is now a big fan of attention and looks like a beautiful panther! She likes to snuggle up with her kennel mates and occasionally will play with some toys. Give her some pets - she’ll love it.

title: Tabby
description:
Female | ~1-2 years
Tabby came to us as a stray in August 2025. She has become more social and affectionate recently and we are so happy to see her happy! But, she would sure be happier in a loving home and out of the kennel. We hope you come and fall in love with this gorgeous gal!

title: Starry
description:
Male | ~1 year
Starry was brought in as a stray in August 2025. He is in a walk in with other kitty friends. He is very playful and loves toys and scratchers. He can be a little shy at first, but once he knows you want to pet him, he’s a happy boy! He’s becoming vocal for more attention and loves to give his kennel pals massages - it’s ADORABLE.

title: Uri
description:
Female | Born 2023
Uri was surrendered to us in August 2025. Unfortunately, her owners could no longer care for her and her sibling cats. Despite her story, Uri is an extremely sweet cat. She loves pets and is very snuggly.

title: Finn
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~2 years)
Finn came in as a stray in October 2025. Since his first day here, he has been extremely sweet. He is in our cattery with other cats and does well. You’ll often find him snuggled up in a bed but will get up to come greet you.

title: Ezra
description:
Male | 17+ years
Ezra was one of the 5 cats that came from the hoarding situation on November 20th. He’s a very old cat but still has quite the energy in him! He will eat anything you give him and will constantly want more. He’s a skinny boy so we have no problem feeding him extra! He likes to walk around to explore and enjoy some pets. He does have a bit of a wobbly walk but the vet says it is nothing to be concerned with. He does appear to be deaf, or going deaf but his eyes are working just fine. Ezra would not do well in a home with younger kids or big dogs and certain stairs would be a struggle for him. An older chill dog would work out fine, we think. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Grace
description:
Female | 14+ years
Grace was one of the 5 cats that came from the hoarding situation on November 20th. She was also severely matted and had to be shaved. Her hair has been growing back nicely! She gets a bit startled by noises and hides but quickly realizes she’s safe and comes back out. She loves to snuggle up on some blankets and enjoys head rubs. Grace does not like other cats and would do best as the only pet in a quiet home. 
Grace likely has a tumor so we’d like to find her a foster for her final months.

title: Cleo Catra
description:
Female | Born April 2022
Probably no other animals | Indoor only
Cleo Catra came to us on 3.27.26. She is a sweet girl that adores pets and is just a little unsure in her new environment. Cleo does not like other animals and will pee on things if other animals are present in the home. She does not like big groups so would do best in a quiet home with fewer people. She might not do well with younger children. She is affectionate to her human and it was a hard surrender for her former owner. Orange females are rare and she’s a total catch.

title: Esmeralda
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No kids, preferably no other pets
Esmeralda and her grey Tortie sister, Eleanor, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Esmeralda does lick when she’s stressed so she has some bald patches or spots with thin hair - she’s still a beauty though! Esmeralda would love to join an adult or two in a quiet home. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Esmeralda will come with her automatic feeder when adopted.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Eleanor
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No kids, no other pets
Eleanor and her Tortie sister, Esmeralda, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Eleanor is a little spicy and would do best in a quiet home with only a few adults that respected her space - she’ll come to you when she wants affection. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Eleanor will come with her automatic feeder when adopted. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Simba
description:
Male | 3 years
No dogs
Simba is back with us at no fault of his own. He’s a bit nervous being back and is trying to find his groove. He would love to find a home where he can play and lounge with his humans (he does well with all ages) as he is a total lover and loves to be with his people. He is currently in our cattery, where he resided before. Simba is not a fan of dogs.

title: Prego
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~5 years)
No dogs, preferably no cats
Hailey’s favorite kitty! Prego came to us as a pregnant stray in January 2026. She gave birth to 4 healthy babies and they have all been adopted. Like her, they were all named after sauces! Prego is an extremely affectionate cat with a bobtail that enjoys watching out the window, growling at anything out of the ordinary - she’d make a great guard dog! Prego loves to be pet, enjoys lounging around, and is always eager to say “hello!” She is currently in the cattery in her own kennel, where she has more room to roam and to be around other cats and we are curious if she’ll warm up to other kitties now that she doesn’t have kittens. Prego enjoys giving humans kisses!

title: Garfield
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~3-4 years)
Garfield came to us on 5/7/26 after being abandoned in a carrier here in town. He is microchipped but the number led us to a dead end. You can re-register this sweet boy when you adopt him, which is great! He’s a little shy, quite gentle for his size, and so very handsome! He likes a good hug/snuggle. We think a quiet home would be best for him. He’s large and ready to enjoy dinner dates and couch snuggles at home with you - make room! He’d probably eat some lasagna, but we don’t recommend it… ;)

title: Cypress
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~5 years)
Cypress came to us on 5.8.26 after being abandoned at Camp 5. He is quite the handsome fella and eager to meet new people and get attention and affections. We aren’t sure how he does with other cats as he’s a bit hissy at them, but he could be all hiss and no bite… He’s relaxed and doesn’t seem too stressed at shelter life but deserves so much more than a kennel. We hope you fall in love with him!

title: Floki
description:
Male | Born 2023
This handsome void came to us 5/19/26 after his owners moved and couldn’t take him and his siblings with. They were loved and it wasn’t an easy choice… Floki loves to be held like a baby and is the biggest baby of the group (in the cutest way). He has a crooked tail that doesn’t bother him and adds some charm. He and his siblings are together in a walk-in kennel. They are not bonded but all get along.

title: Lily
description:
Female | Born 1/26/21
This girl came to us 5/19/26 after her owners moved and couldn’t take her and her siblings with. They were loved and it wasn’t an easy choice… Lily is the oldest of the group of kitties she came in with and can and will approve belly pets, but remember - on her terms, of course! Her and her siblings are together in a walk-in kennel. They are not bonded but all get along.

title: Chappy
description:
Male | Born Dec. 2021 
Chappy and his brother came to us on 5.21.26. Chappy is smaller than his brother and has some white spots on his toes, chest, and some white “frosting” on his ears. He is front declawed and very friendly - he’d love to make your lap his new favorite spot. The boys are not bonded, but do get along well and are finding comfort in each other in their new environment. Chappy is a big fan of butt scratches (as pictured here).

title: Eve
description:
Female | 8-9 weeks 
Eve came to us as a stray on 5.16.26 at around 7-8 weeks old. She came in with a bad upper respiratory infection and finally feeling better and is full of spunk! If she doesn’t have a kitty friend to play with, she will most certainly hunt you, wrestle you, and squeeze in some lovin’s too.

title: Kamp
description:
Male | 8-9 weeks 
Kamp, his brother Fyre, and their mom, Smores were brought in on 5.26.26 after being dumped out on some property. They are a little sassy but very sweet and play hard. Kamp is more timid but not afraid to bring his best kitten energy.

title: Smores
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~1-2 years)
No other cats
Smores came in with her kittens, Kamp and Fyre, on 5.26.26 after being dumped out on some property. She is happy to be aware from her needy boys and relaxing after all her hard work as a mom. She does not appear to like other cats.

title: Lawrence
description:
Male | Undetermined age 
Lawrence came to us on 5.26.26 after living as a stray. He is a little feisty but is up front to try to work on socializing. The family that kept tabs on him said he was a sweet kitty that they could hold so we look forward to meeting this version of him!

title: Nova
description:
Female | Australian Shepherd Mix | 6 yrs
No young children, No cats
Nova is back from her foster adventure! We learned that she really will do best with only one human in the house and being the only pet. She still needs slow introductions even when in her new home. She had great manners without accidents in her foster home and was not destructive so she would not need to be kenneled when left home alone. Please ask questions and we’d be happy to get you in touch with her former foster dad if you want to get to know her more! 
Our longest term resident! Nova was brought in with a male dog and a puppy in 2022, though she remains. Being in the shelter for so long has made her reactive and sassy, therefore she requires a slow introduction. For most new introductions we muzzle her to keep everyone safe. Once she is comfortable with you, she is very affectionate. We call her “Our Princess.” 
She does not get along with female dogs but has shown little to no aggression towards male dogs. Give her some time, you’ll love her as much as we do! 
Nova weighs around 30 pounds.

title: Peyton
description:
Male | Lab/St. Bernard/German Shepherd | 7 yrs
Careful with children, Some Dogs 
Peyton came to us on 12/29/25. He’s a big, bouncy, and kind of naughty boy - Peyton has unfortunately used his teeth in ways he’s not supposed to, but does know sit, stay, and shake! Once he knows you, he really is a sweet boy. He’s got the most handsome bark and would do nearly anything for food or treats! Peyton loves small stuffed toys, car rides, chewable treats, bones, and snuggles. Be prepared for a little drool on his favorite toys.
Peyton weighs 85 pounds.

title: Chase
description:
Male | Pitbull Mix | 1 year
Some dogs, Careful with children
This cute little man came to us for Christmas! Based on his behavior, we’re quite sure he was born and raised in a kennel setting, therefore, he does well in a kennel. We’re working on commands, he knows “sit,” and “down.” He is quite loud and a little protective of his space, so slow introductions are best. It may take a couple of interactions to win him over, but once you do, he won’t get out of your lap!
For a pup, he’s a hefty 50 pounds!

title: Lilac
description:
Female | Coohound Mix | Born 8/5/2022
No young kids(12+) no cats, some dogs
This pretty lady came to us on 4/7/2026. She is a great dog who is just a bit particular. She’s not a big fan of some people (some men, some elderly) and does not get along with all dogs in a household setting. Lilac has been to doggy daycare in Rapid City at Meadowridge Pet Lodge, and gets along with dogs in a neutral setting. She has some separation anxiety and can be a bit destructive when left home alone, though she hasn’t shown any destructive behavior spending nights with one of our employees. She is not a fan of small children. If you have further question regarding Lilac, please reach out through our email. Lilac weighs around 50 lbs.

title: Gus
description:
Male | Lab Mix | ~8 years
So far, Gus seems to like everyone and everything
Gus was brought to us as a stray on 4/24/26. No one came for this sweet old man. We aren’t sure how he feels about cats (seems like he’s hunting them but might just be curious) yet seems fine with his neighboring dogs. He’s very sweet and well-mannered, though he likes to jump up on you when he’s excited! We aren’t sure of his age - his face says 10 but the vet guesses 8 years. regardless of age, Gus gets around great! He jumps into cars, runs to his kennels, pulls our dog walkers around, and digs to his hearts’ content! Gus weighs about 74 lbs.

title: Cutlass
description:
Male | Heeler/Doberman Mix | Born 3/8/23
No cats, no male dogs, no small kids(12+)
Cutlass came to us on 4/30/26 after his owner passed away. He does not like cats or male dogs, though he doesn’t seem to mind female dogs. We think he would do better with older kids, a fenced yard, and/or living with someone who is very active! Cutlass has a lot energy to burn and absolutely loves the water! He’s a lake or creek playing dog for sure. Cutlass is a little finicky upon new introductions, but once he warms up, he’s a real hambone. We invite you to come visit him and see if you could be his next best friend! Cutlass is 50 lbs.

title: Gertie Mae
description:
Female | Akbash | ~3 years
So far, Gertie seems to get along with everyone and everything
Gertie Mae joined us on 5/2/26 and has adjusted well! She’s a big lap dog whose only flaw is food aggression. We’ve noticed it mostly towards other dogs, so separate feeding areas would be required in a multi-dog home. (Best to keep human hands away for safety as well.) She does like to bark and alert her family of anything out of the ordinary, keeping true to her breed! Gertie is also a tricky nail trimmer, she does not like her feet being touched! She has lived with other dogs, cats, and kids. 
Gertie weighs around 80 lbs.

title: Guster
description:
Male | Shepherd Mix | Born 2025
No cats, some dogs, great with kids
Guster (formally Junior) is back with us after not fitting in with his family. They gave it a go but he did not get along with the family cat and did not care for one of the family members who owns their own dogs outside of their house. Unfortunately, it did end with a bite. Guster is a squeaker-removing champion, a lover of hard squeaking toys, and a bit of a fence jumper. He does very well with younger kids and would do best as the only pet, but we can facilitate a meet-and-greet with another dog to see if they get along. Guster weighs 40 lbs.

title: Akasha
description:
Female | Shepherd/Heeler/Husky Mix | Born 4/17/23
No cats, careful with kids, some dogs
Akasha and her “sister,” Harlequinn, are with us after not being able to return home. They are sweet girls that get along with each other but don’t seem to be a big fan of other dogs and would probably chase cats if given the chance. Akasha seems a bit more willing to meet other dogs. We know they are both playful and enjoy human companionship. 
Akasha weighs 42 pounds

title: Harlequinn
description:
Female | Lab/Pit Mix | Born 3/20/24
No other dogs
Harlequinn and her “sister,” Akasha, are with us after not being able to return home. They are sweet girls and get along with each other but don’t seem to be a big fan of other dogs and would probably chase cats if given the chance. We know they are both playful and enjoy human companionship. Harley is a lover of people and jumps up on you when she’s excited!
Harlequinn weighs 48 pounds

title: Rex
description:
Male | Mini (Toy) Aussie | Born 12/14/24
No young kids, some male dogs
Rex came to us 6/2/26 after some behavioral issues persisted in his former home. He is not a fan of children (has nipped) and only gets along with some male dogs. He’s small but mighty - Rex is protective of his humans, especially females. He’s never been on a leash so that’s been a scary experience but he does follow well without one. Rex has lived with humans of various ages, cats, livestock and chickens. He knows some commands like “sit” and “lay” and he’s working on “stay.” He is microchipped, enjoys an active lifestyle, and although he drools in the car, he doesn’t get sick. Maybe this handsome fella will fit into your home! We welcome you to come meet this sweet guy and help him gain some confidence. 
Weight coming soon!

title: Mocha
description:
Female | English Mastador/Lab Mix | Born 2025
Spay appt sch 6/10/26 
—
 available prior w/ spay deposit
Mocha and her sister, Shyra, came to us on 6/4/26 after their owner could no longer care for them. We are still getting to know them but we are told they take a while to warm up to men, they are pretty cautious, they don’t like the car, but they enjoy going for walks and running around playing with toys. Mocha is the more confident of the two. We look forward to getting to know these beauties and sharing more about them in the near future! They do get along but do not have to be adopted together. Enjoy the photo of this gal singing the song of her people on arrival.

title: Shyra
description:
Female | English Mastador/Lab Mix | Born 2025
Spay appt sch 6/10/26 
—
 available prior w/ spay deposit
Shyra and her sister, Mocha, came to us on 6/4/26 after their owner could no longer care for them. We are still getting to know them but we are told they take a while to warm up to men, they are pretty cautious, they don’t like the car, but they enjoy going for walks and running around playing with toys. Shyra is the more timid of the two. We look forward to getting to know these beauties and sharing more about them in the near future! They do get along but do not have to be adopted together. Enjoy the photo of this gal singing the song of her people on arrival.
